total_model.summary: Model projects 40.2 total points (TEN 18, CLE 22). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 3.6), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.4), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 2.4). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
